skill.description: A remote MCP server that curates Korean AEC (architecture · engineering · construction) expertise for your agent. Codes and statutes (KDS, KCS, KS, building law) sit on one graph with practice rules, theory, work sequences and causes, so it answers not only *where* something is written but *why* it holds, *what comes first*, and *how two methods differ*. Every answer carries its grounds; with no grounds it stays silent instead of guessing.
